steps.text: It's all thanks to you and everyone else at the fire department that there were no causalities in this rescue operation. On behalf of all of Lungmen, please accept my thanks.

steps.text: Very well, I'll agree to this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: However, I also expect to see an acceptably feasible proposal for an information campaign of this scale.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And since you requested it, it falls on you to put together this proposal. If you want to see it happen soon, I'm afraid you won't be getting any of that vacation time for your reward.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I took a quick glance at your file and work logs before our meeting.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Your performance in school was impeccable, and I'm confident you could find yourself a much better line of work, if you wished.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: As for your current job, it seems you are unparalleled in the field. Your logs show that, up until today, you've been volunteering your own time to patrol on the weekends for the past two months?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Relax, this is nothing formal. If you would prefer not to answer, you have the right. This is just my own personal curiosity asking.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What drives you to go so far?

steps.text: WhenIwasakid, therewasastorenotfaraway frommyschool. Ilovedthatplace. WheneverIdidsomethingright, myparentswould takemethere tobuysomenuts asareward.

steps.text: This must be gruesome work to do day after day.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: This isn't an official inquiry. You may answer honestly.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Can you bear with it and remain steadfast to your position?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lungmen is lucky to have a young woman like you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Now put your proposal together. I will arrange for a liaison to reach out. If you are going to do it, then give it your best effort... Do not come to regret your decision!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I thank all of you, for all that you have done for Lungmen.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: What about you... Are you with the Lungmen Fire Department?

steps.text: I knew it! I got the right person...! I didn't expect to bump into you here!

steps.text: I'm not sure if you remember, but it was that accident caused by the heater that's against regulations? I think it was a pretty big deal. Master Wei even took it upon himself to do some fire safety PSAs.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: All of them are really thankful for everything you've done, and they've been paying extra care to the safety code. The city's awareness campaign was right after that... I learned so much because of that.

steps.name: Waai Fu

steps.name: Waai Fu

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Oh, right... I forgot to mention. My classmate is looking to join the fire department, and she's prepping for the exam now.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: That's perfect! I know she's got to be studying so hard for her exam day after day. I bet she'll be so jealous if she finds out I met you here!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Not at all. It's no exaggeration.

steps.name: Waai Fu
